name: Strength, Courage, and Trials
description: Bold Bang Bouldern from the Collective of Plenty seems to be planning some kind of exciting activity with your old friend...

dialogs.content: Miss Bold Bang, is your lower back still hurting?
I'm good now... That hot compress worked like a charm!
Heh, to make a hot compress like this, you have to heat the wet bandage with slow-burning gunpowder for just the right amount of time, or you might end up setting it on fire.
Only Yoimiya would come up with a way to warm up bandages like that!
#Hold on a second... Look who's here! Our hero both in name and deed, and {M#his}{F#her} little white companion!
Is this the part where a woven scroll comic scene unfolds right in front of me...?
Hey! Are you helping patch her up?
Oh, please don't worry about me! I was just wandering about in the wild, looking for some new tough opponents to practice against.
Miss Yoimiya here was really a great help to me when I accidentally hurt my back and tumbled down the hill like a snowball!
Oof... That sounds painful...
Heh, to quote The Soulblazer Saga, "I'm merely a warrior who happened to pass by"...
And now, we can make that a "free mercenary"! The Knights have granted me permission to take action and deal with monsters as I see fit.
Sounds like there are still monsters lurking, then?
Things don't look so good... Should we contact the Knights and ask for reinforcements?
True, we can't afford to be careless, but the situation isn't that urgent yet.
The Knights have already cleared out the monsters around the International Cross Country Challenge venue, and there are only a few stragglers wandering about at this point.
And honestly, there are quite a few adventurers competing in the challenge who can hold their own anyway.
They have the strength, skills, and courage. If we treat them like we do the regular folks, they might end up feeling insulted instead.
So, in line with usual practice at the Adventurers' Guild, we're treating this as a trial, and we've formed a team on the spot to deal with those monsters.
And that's exactly what the Trial of Valor is about: clearing monsters, emulating various heroes' combat styles, and transcending your own limits!
Now that's the kind of thinking you'd expect from the Collective of Plenty!
Then I definitely want to be a part of this!
#Awesome! It's been a while since I last saw you in action, {NICKNAME}.
I'm really excited to see your skills now... I wonder, what kind of fireworks can I compare your dazzling moves to?
I'm not missing out on this either, that's for sure!
We'll have to act with caution since there are civilians in the area too.
Have you just been through a battle?
